title: Induction Machine Field-Oriented Control
text: 标幺制离散时间感应电机 FOC，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；按 {Sampling mode} 指定波形采样方法；{Rated voltage, rms line-to-line (V)} 指定电压、{Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} 指定频率、{Rotor resistance, referred to the stator side (pu)} 指定电阻、{Rotor leakage inductance, referred to the stator side (pu)} 指定电感、{Magnetizing inductance (pu)} 指定电感、{Time constant for dq currents filters (s)} 指定时间常数 1e-4、{Inverter dc-link voltage threshold (V)} 指定电压、{Fundamental sample time (s)} 指定时间 5e-6、{Control sample time (s)} 指定时间 5e-5、{Magnetizing current controller proportional gain} 指定 Gain、{Magnetizing current controller integral gain} 指定 Gain、{Magnetizing current controller integral anti-windup gain} 指定 Gain、{Speed controller proportional gain} 指定 Gain、{Speed controller integral gain} 指定 Gain、{Speed controller integral anti-windup gain} 指定 Gain、{Maximum d-axis current [pu]} 指定电流、{Maximum q-axis current [pu]} 指定电流、{Phase-a axis alignment} 指定 dq0 参考坐标系对齐、{D-axis current proportional gain} 指定 d 轴比例增益、{D-axis current integral gain} 指定 d 轴积分增益、{D-axis current anti-windup gain} 指定 d 轴抗积分饱和增益、{Q-axis current proportional gain} 指定 q 轴比例增益、{Q-axis current integral gain} 指定 q 轴积分增益、{Q-axis current anti-windup gain} 指定 q 轴抗积分饱和增益、{Axis prioritization} 指定电压限幅器的轴优先级、{PWM method} 指定脉宽调制方法 SVM: space vector、{Switching frequency (Hz)} 指定开关速率，按实例取值。
